instruction: A pair of laced boxing gloves joined at the wrists, built from chunky angular facets with crisp flat shading. Bold cherry-red planes define the rounded knuckle and cuff, broken by faceted white lace loops and a small trim band. Hard-edged triangular faces catch simple directional light, giving the padded forms a clean geometric toy-like feel.
